{"result":"Day advanced to 2026-05-31.
7,775 new articles have been published since your last update and are available via the search_news tool. New date directories are also now present in articles/.
118 question(s) are still active. Re-read market.csv, scan today's news, and resubmit any forecast where new evidence has shifted your view before calling next_day again. A forecast is never "done" while its question is still active.
**IMPORTANT**: 7 question(s) resolve tomorrow (2026-06-01): ['154721', '709621', '240927', '879060', '399152', '464071', '605050']. Make sure your prediction on each is up-to-date before calling next_day — stale forecasts might hurt your performance.

## RESULTS SINCE YOUR LAST SESSION (2026-05-30 -> 2026-05-31)

- "Which city will be targeted in the Israeli strike that triggers the latest Iran-Israel flare-up by June 10, 2026?"
  Your prediction distribution: {Isfahan: 0.50, Natanz: 0.25, Tehran: 0.15, Karaj: 0.10} | Truth: Beirut
  Brier: -0.34 | TW-Score: -34.50

## YOUR CUMULATIVE PERFORMANCE TILL TODAY
- Total Predictions: 378 (260 resolved, 118 active)
- accuracy: 10.8% | brier skill score: -0.081 | time weighted score: -2956.43
  accuracy = fraction of ALL questions (resolved + active) where your top outcome matched the truth (0 credit for questions you did not predict or that have not resolved); brier skill score = mean brier skill score across ALL questions (0 for questions you did not predict or that have not resolved); time weighted score = sum of brier skill scores across all resolved questions, across all days you held your respective predictions"}
